title: Imagining the nation: schools, history books and novels
goal: Read how schools, books and novels helped to imagine the nation, and use the passive with ser to say who presented what.

items: Use the passive with *ser* (*fueron presentados como padres de la patria*) to say how heroes and books were presented.
Say what schools and history books taught about the nation.
Say who wrote the novel María and when it was published.
Say what Anderson thinks about an imagined nation.
Use the key words of this lesson: author, reader, landscape, tool, critic and Colombian.
